sentences.text: 2. During pendency of the appeal, matter has been amicably settled between the contesting parties.
3. Statements of learned counsel for respective parties have been recorded in the Court.
1 Whether reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

4. In his statement, Mr.Virender Sharma, learned counsel, for respondent No.1-Royal Sundaram Alliance Insurance Company Ltd., has deposed as under:-
.

entities.text: Royal Sundaram Alliance Insurance Company Ltd.
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: "I am representing respondent No.1- Insurance Company.
I am competent and duly authorized to make statement on behalf of respondent No.1-Insurance Company, as per instructions imparted to me by the Zonal Manager of the Insurance Company.

During pendency of the appeal, respondent No.1-Insurance Company had offered payment of compensation of `5,20,000/- in lump sum in addition to the compensation already awarded by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Kinnaur at Rampur Bushahr, District Shimla, H.P. in present case, and offer has been accepted by the appellant and, therefore, this appeal may be disposed of in terms of compromise.

As per compromise, Insurance Company, shall pay the aforesaid amount on or before 15.09.2023, by remitting the same in the Bank Account of the appellant directly, but after supply of Bank Account details of the petitioner to respondent No.1- Insurance Company, either directly or through learned counsel.
Respondent No.1-Insurance Company prays for deciding the appeal in terms of compromise.

My aforesaid deposition is strictly in consonance with instructions imparted to me by Zonal Manager of respondent No.1-Insurance Company."
5.

In his statement, Mr.Parveen Chandel, learned counsel, for the appellant, has deposed as under:-
"I have heard statement of Mr.Virender Sharma, Advocate.
As per instructions imparted to me, I endorse the terms of compromise explained in the deposition of Mr.Virender Sharma, Advocate.

Appellant has accepted the enhancement of `5,20,000/- in lump sum payable on or before 15.09.2023 in .
addition to the compensation already awarded by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Kinnaur at Rampur Bushahr, District Shimla, H.P..
The appeal may be decided in terms of compromise.
Bimla Devi vs Royal Sundaram Alliance Insurance on 17 July, 2023

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126642337/
2 My aforesaid deposition is strictly in consonance with instructions imparted to me by the appellant."

6. In view of above, appeal is disposed of in terms of compromise and respondent No.1-Insurance Company is directed to pay `5,20,000/- in lump sum, as full and final payment of enhanced compensation in addition to amount of compensation already awarded, on or before 15.09.2023.

In case amount is not paid on or before 15.09.2023, then respondent No.1-Insurance Company shall be liable to pay interest @ 7.5% per annum on the amount from the date of filing of petition, i.e.
23.09.2016 till final realization of the amount.
7. Appellant is also directed to supply details of bank account to respondent No.1-Insurance Company either in person or through learned counsel, within one week from today.
8. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.

9. Parties are permitted to produce copy of this judgment, downloaded from the web-page of the High Court of Himachal Pradesh, before the authorities concerned, and the said authorities shall not insist for production of a certified copy but if required, may verify passing of judgment from Website of the High Court.
.

(Vivek Singh Thakur), Judge.
 July 17, 2023  (Purohit)
